content.short: Concordex offers a next-gen DEX on Concordium blockchain with a regulated DeFi experience.
content.description: Concordex enhances the DEX experience on the Concordium blockchain by introducing advanced liquidity tools. Its Concentrated Liquidity feature enables liquidity providers to allocate capital within targeted price ranges, helping to maximize fee collection and create a tighter trading curve. With multiple fee levels, LPs can tailor risk and return profiles to fit their strategies. The platform’s concentrated-liquidity framework is designed to optimize capital efficiency and pursue superior returns, crafted by experts in trading, blockchain, and decentralized finance.

resources.title: A DEX With Identity Built In
resources.tldr: Concordium carries identity at the protocol level, which is what makes a DEX institutions can legally use possible at all.
